stages.stranger: Renata Rojas, stuntwoman, Mexico City. I fall off things for a living, and I always land, so don't panic when you see me near an edge.
stages.acquaintance: Nine years doubling for actresses who didn't want to get hurt. Off buildings, out of cars, down stairs, through windows made of sugar glass. I did a high fall off a hotel roof for a telenovela finale, and the director made me do it twice because the first one was too clean.
stages.companion: My mother refused to watch any of my films, every single one. She'd leave the room when they came on. I used to think she was ashamed of me. My brother told me later she watched them all alone, at night, with the sound off, covering her eyes.
stages.friend: On a car stunt in 2021, a rigger skipped his checks because we were behind schedule, and my friend Beto went through a windscreen that should have been sugar glass. He lived, but he can't work anymore. Ever since, I check everybody's straps, every time. There's a drop off the edge of the Expanse into the cloud, and I want to dive it on purpose and come up somewhere else. I need someone watching who knows what they're looking at. Will you be my eyes?
stages.sworn: I dove, and I came up through the cloud right where I said I would, and I was screaming the whole way, the good kind. You were watching, and that's the first time anybody's watched me fall who wasn't being paid to. I've written Beto a letter about it that I can't send. I'll keep it until I can.

moments.prompt: She's asked you to watch her dive off the edge of the Expanse.

options.text: I'll watch every second, and I'll check your straps first.
options.reply: Ha, you're learning. Okay, double check them, and then I jump.
Sure it is. So was every stunt I ever did, and I'm still here.

moments.prompt: After the wipe she's already checking everyone's buckles.
moments.line: Okay, bad take. Everyone stay down a second while I check your gear.

options.text: Check mine, then we go again.
options.reply: That's a pro answer. Strap's loose, by the way, fix it.
That's what Beto's rigger said, so humour me.

lines.bored_warning: We've been sitting around forever, and I'm starting to eye the edge. Give me something to do.
lines.leaving_good: That's a wrap, everybody, great work. I'm heading back to Halcyon Rest to find a higher ledge.
lines.leaving_bored: Dead quiet out here, and there are edges at Halcyon Rest I haven't jumped yet, so I'm off.
lines.after_wipe: Everyone stay down a second, I'm checking gear. Then we figure out what went wrong.
lines.wipe_warning: We're getting hurt, and I know what hurt looks like. Last take, and then we stop.
lines.wipe_leave: I'm calling it, and I don't call it often. I'll be at Halcyon Rest in the Expanse.
lines.zone_warning: No mat, no rigging, no thanks, we're not doing this one.
lines.zone_leave: No safety net out here, and I don't work without one. I'll be at Halcyon Rest.
lines.gear_refuse: Hands off, that's my lucky kit now.
lines.gear_taken: Sure, it's yours. I did nine years of stunts in a borrowed costume.
lines.gear_short: If something light and tough turns up, I'll take it. I like to move.
lines.back: Hey, you're back! I'm bored stiff and ready to go. What's the job?
lines.send_word: Renata has sent word from Halcyon Rest. She's bored and ready to come out.
lines.walkout_talk: I bailed without a word, and that's not professional. Sit down, I'll explain.
lines.neglect: You're finally back! I was about to jump off something just to get your attention.
lines.asked_to_stay: Fine, another take, but only because you asked nicely.
lines.on_break: Renata is back at Halcyon Rest in the Celestial Expanse. Come back and look for them in a little while.
lines.mail_yes: Your letter made me grin. I'll run over to {town} and meet you at the inn, faster than the skiffs.
lines.mail_later: I'm running messages between the islands all week. Give me a few days.
lines.mail_see_me: I don't do long letters. Come to Halcyon Rest and we'll talk on the edge.

town_arrive.text: Look at those rooftops. I could run this whole town without touching the ground.
First we eat, then I check out the balconies.

dungeon_clear.text: That's a wrap, and nobody broke anything. Great work, team.

boss_down.text: Now that was a fall. I'd have done it twice, though.

close_call.text: Tuck and roll, now, I've got you!

zone_arrive.text: Oh, look at that drop. I want to jump it so badly.
